title: US Warns of Growing Houthi–Al-Shabaab Operational Links
detail: The United States has warned of growing operational and logistical links between the Houthis in Yemen and Al-Shabaab in Somalia, raising regional security concerns about a potential convergence of two major militant networks across the Horn of Africa and Arabian Peninsula. The warning underscores fears that cross-network cooperation could enhance both groups' capabilities and complicate counterterrorism efforts in the region.

media.caption: US warns of Houthi–Al-Shabaab operational convergence across Horn of Africa
